svg.text: AWS Secure Baseline — Multi-Account Security Platform
GuardDuty · Security Hub · CloudTrail · AWS Config · SCPs · Terraform · GitHub Actions
AWS Organizations — SCP Layer (enforced above IAM, cannot be overridden)
GitHub Actions CI/CD — OIDC (no stored credentials)
Multi-Account Topology — Blast Radius Isolated by Design
Separate AWS account · OIDC role: github-actions-non-prod
Separate AWS account · OIDC role: github-actions-prod (approval required)
Security Modules — Deployed Identically Across Every Environment
Layered Detection — Every Layer Catches What the Others Miss
